rebind.method: Each record whose bound file changed was compared with the bound bytes, found in the history by their SHA-256, occurrence by occurrence (form, columns, line span and SHA-256 of the spanned lines); then derive/reviewed.mjs --write rewrote every binding from the tracked tree. The rescan pairing ignores stored spans, so the rescan counts are unchanged by the rebind itself.
